# FG-AUTH-0010

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`user-offboarding`](../../ops/runbooks/user-offboarding.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `administration_orphaned_is_reported_for_no_admin_and_an_ownerless_group` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 管理者またはグループの Owner がいない状態です。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: There is no administrator or a group has no Owner. Contact the administrator.
- id: Tidak ada administrator atau sebuah grup tidak memiliki Owner. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

forge doctor (check users.administration) found forge without an active human administrator, a top-level group without a direct active Owner, or a project (not pending deletion) without any active Owner, direct or inherited (forge_db::projects::ownerless, D4 MR4). This is what a forced disable (`forge admin user disable --force`) leaves behind, or a disable / demotion done outside forge-db. Nobody can then administer forge, or manage that group's members, until it is recovered. A forge with no users at all (a new install) is reported as `warn` without this code. Since M3 S0 the check `service_accounts.ownerless` reports it too (`reason=ownerless_service_account`): an active service account whose owner is disabled (offboarding did not hand it on) or that has no profile — nobody answers for its tokens.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The doctor line carries `reason` (no_admin when there is no active human administrator, otherwise ownerless_group), `active_human_admins`, `ownerless_groups` (how many top-level groups have no direct active Owner) and `group_ids` (the first 10 of them); a project finding carries `reason=ownerless_project`, `ownerless_projects` and `project_ids` (the first 10); a service account finding (check `service_accounts.ownerless`) carries `reason=ownerless_service_account`, `ownerless_service_accounts` and `user_ids` (the first 10; `gstn admin service-account view <id>` shows the owner). The audit log shows how it happened: SELECT created_at, actor_label, request_id, details FROM forge.audit_log WHERE action = 'user.disabled' AND details->>'forced' = 'true' ORDER BY id DESC.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook user-offboarding: as an approved step, run `forge admin bootstrap-admin --user <username>` (or `--create`) to restore an administrator. Top-level groups without an Owner cannot be fixed yet (no member-change command or route exists in D3): record the listed group_ids in the incident record; the finding stays (warn) until a member-change route lands and an active user is made their Owner. Re-run forge doctor after each step. For `ownerless_service_account` follow runbook service-accounts: give the account a new owner (`gstn admin service-account update <id> --owner <user id>`) or, when it is no longer needed, disable it (`gstn user disable <id> --yes`, which revokes its tokens).
